meta.name: Petite Maman
meta.description: After the death of her beloved grandmother, eight-year-old Nelly meets a strangely familiar girl her own age in the woods. Instantly forming a connection with this mysterious new friend, Nelly embarks on a fantastical journey of discovery which helps her come to terms with this newfound loss.
meta.slogan: Experience a fairytale of wonder and innocence.
